messages:
Ava: Quick poll — if Redwood had a theme song for 2026, drop one line of the chorus that we can actually sing in the kitchen. No full songs, just one-liners. Go!
Devon: 'Ship it, ship it, ship it faster' :rocket:
Riley: 'Low latency, high vibes' :headphones:
Priya: 'Patch, push, picnic.' :sandwich: :laughing:
Ava: 'Cache me if you can' :sunglasses: (yes, I'm that dad)
OpsBot: OpsBot: New poll created: "Office anthem candidate" — react with :+1: to vote.
Devon: +1 for 'Low latency, high vibes' — short and usable in an elevator. :thumbsup:
Priya: Also proposing a coffee solo in the bridge: 'Espresso for the brave' :coffee:
Riley: Can we get a spontaneous clapping break after every successful deploy? 'Clap, clap, ship!' :clap:
Ava: OK chorus drafted: 'Low latency, high vibes' — coffee solo optional. GIF incoming.
Devon: :eyes: honestly better than my line, I'll concede.
Priya: posting GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/dance-teamwork-3o6ZsYp4G0bJQZ0E7a
Riley: vote tally so far: :+1: x3 (Devon, Riley, Priya) — Ava, you got a few admirers for the cache line though. :sparkles:
Ava: Fine, we'll alternate choruses. Office anthem officially chaotic. :party_parrot:
